name: ibmq_20_tokyo_sabre_fig2 (design graph, 43 edges)
note: IBM Q20 Tokyo as drawn in Fig. 2 of Li, Ding, Xie (ASPLOS 2019, arXiv:1809.02573): 4 x 5 grid with all horizontal and vertical couplers plus the 12 X couplers 1-7, 2-6, 3-9, 4-8, 5-11, 6-10, 7-13, 8-12, 11-17, 12-16, 13-19, 14-18. Identical to qmap.tokyo_edges(), the graph used by the verifier, the SABRE reference counts and every result in this deposit. Undirected. (v1.0 of this deposit shipped Qiskit's 35-edge FakeTokyo map under this file name by mistake; that map is now tokyo_coupling_fake_tokyo_35.json.)
